title: Nuitka: Compile Python Into a Standalone Executable
description: Learn to compile Python into a standalone executable with Nuitka. Compare standalone and onefile builds, test speed, and see when PyInstaller fits better.
summary: Nuitka is a Python compiler that turns your code into a native executable. Its distribution modes let you package an application to run on a compatible machine without a separate Python installation.
takeaways: Get Your Code: Click here to download the free sample code you’ll use to compile Python into standalone executables with Nuitka and benchmark the results.

You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz Nuitka: Compile Python Into a Standalone Executable Test your understanding of compiling Python with Nuitka, from standalone and onefile builds to speedups and when PyInstaller fits better.
Note: On Windows, Nuitka’s downloadable MinGW64 toolchain doesn’t normally support Python 3.13 or newer.
